_about: Signal points for the CFB card. Every number here is the single source; model.py reads it. 'bt' = walk-forward backtest vs consensus closing spread or total, FBS vs FBS regular season. Thresholds chosen on 2017-2022, checked on 2023-2025. Run 2026-10-29 from the cfb-card repo cache (games/lines/talent 2016-2025). Break-even at -110 is 52.4%.
point_rule: 2 points: both halves above 52.4% and the full-sample 95% interval above 50%. 1 point: both halves above 51%. 0: anything else (shown, not scored). Signals with no historical data cannot be tested; Action Network signals keep the NHL card's points, injuries and weather are shown and logged but score 0 until a season of logged results exists. Action Network signals use one season (2026 weeks 1-8) split in halves, so their points are provisional and are re-checked by the Results tab's Signal check.

ml_floor_why: Moneyline is eligible only between -300 and +300. Shorter favorites take the spread, and so do long underdogs: on a big underdog's moneyline almost no tickets and a lopsided share of money are normal, so the fade-the-public and money-vs-tickets points fire on nearly every one and would push +700 longshots to the top.
scoring: Picks come from rules, not from adding up points. The signal points still decide which side the signals favor (the side with more points), but a pick is made only when that side meets one of the rules below, each tested against every game played this season. Games that meet no rule show No pick. Tier = the rule's evidence: Strong rules held up in both halves of the season, Solid rules only in the later half. The re-check after each college week updates the rules and their records.

rules_fcs._about: FCS pick rules, set Oct 29, 2026 from the FCS-only backtest (fcs_bt.py: FCS vs FCS regular season, 2022-2023 train, 2024-2025 test, 2026 check). FCS favorites lost against the spread every season, so FCS backs underdogs only. Re-checked weekly on FCS games only. recheck_policy.when: Sunday, after Saturday's games are final, before the week's first card. Reruns every test on all games played in each division.
recheck_policy.evaluation: Season to date, a column per month, and the last 3 weeks as an early warning, per division. CFBD consensus close; moneylines at the cleaned median (quotes under 100 or over 5000 dropped, medians in decimal odds); spreads and totals at -110 unless the book's price is known.

qualify.text: A version qualifies at 5+ picks with positive units and a win % above break-even, season to date.

off.text: Season Cards policy (Trina, Nov 9, 2026): season to date decides. A rule switches off once it has the FBS pick minimum (3 graded picks, one quarter of a 12 game season) and its season units are negative; it turns back on when season units are green. The current month is a watch only (a red month on 5+ picks is reported, never switches). Two red months in a row switch a rule off from December (first check Dec 14).

switch.text: A rule moves to its other version only after 30+ picks, when that version wins at least as often, makes more units, and is positive for the season and the current month.

recheck_policy.tier: Rule standing (rule_tier): Strong when the current version qualifies season to date, else Solid. Per pick tier is the signal lead (Strong 4+, Solid 2 to 3, Lean 0 to 1 or behind).
recheck_policy.warning: Any rule negative over the last 3 weeks is reported as a warning; a red month on 5+ picks is reported as Watch (no change made).

locked._why: Price limits set by Trina: favorite moneyline no longer than -200; underdog moneyline +100 to +200.

recheck_policy.picktime: Winning versions are also graded at the card's logged morning lines (hist/pickinputs) when available, else at the CFBD opener as a proxy, so a rule that only works at the close is visible.
